# Project Checklist

- [x] Verify project instructions file exists.
- [x] Clarify requirements: browser-based AI assistant with voice input/output and configurable model endpoint.
- [x] Scaffold project: dependency-free HTML, CSS, and JavaScript in the workspace root.
- [x] Customize project: responsive JARVIS assistant interface, API settings, conversation history, speech controls, and failure states.
- [x] Install required extensions: none required.
- [x] Compile project: no build step; browser interaction and editor diagnostics passed.
- [x] Create and run task: not needed for a static app.
- [x] Launch project: opened and verified in the browser; Python is not installed for local HTTP serving.
- [x] Ensure documentation is complete: README and project instructions are present.
- [x] Publish to GitHub Pages: public repository and live site at https://sreenaath8-blip.github.io/jarvis-personal-assistant/.

## Project Guidance

- Keep the app dependency-free unless a real need arises.
- Never fabricate assistant replies; model responses must come from the configured API.
- Preserve accessible labels, keyboard behavior, responsive layout, and clear voice/API failure states.
- Do not expose personal API keys in public deployments.
